issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares Farm.addAnimal(animal: Animal): boolean, but the intended/template/solution code uses (or implies) a void addAnimal(Animal) (the template/main usage and the solution implementation define addAnimal returning void). This mismatch between the UML and the code can confuse students about the required return type and whether they should return a boolean from addAnimal.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across artifacts. Either change the UML in problem_statement.md to show addAnimal(animal: Animal): void (and update any textual references) or change the template and solution to implement addAnimal returning boolean (and update usages such as Main). Preferably update the UML to void to match the template usage and the solution implementation, and update the problem description to explicitly state that addAnimal adds the animal to the list without requiring a return value.
